questions.question: In [Statistics & Probability], an urn contains $4$ white and $6$ black balls. A second urn contains $5$ white and $5$ black balls. One ball is transferred at random from the first urn to the second urn, and then a ball is drawn from the second urn. What is the probability that the drawn ball is white?
questions.explanation: Solve using rigorous mathematical proofs and transformations in Statistics & Probability.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question:
Evaluate the integer value of the limit in [Statistics & Probability]:
$$\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{x - \sin x}{x^3} \times 6$$
questions.solution: Using Taylor series $\sin x = x - \frac{x^3}{6} + O(x^5)$, we have $\frac{x - \sin x}{x^3} = \frac{1}{6} + O(x^2) \to \frac{1}{6}$. Multiplied by $6$, the value is $1$.
questions.explanation: Derive using rigorous mathematical theorems in Statistics & Probability.
